result.title: FENAS: A Few-Shot Meta-Ensembling Framework for Efficient Neural Architecture Search with Synergized Zero-Cost Proxies
result.summary: Efficient neural architecture search (NAS) requires accurate performance estimation under limited evaluation budgets. Existing zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) provide fast training-free signals, but each proxy usually captures only a partial property of an architecture, leading to unstable rankings across datasets and search spaces. In contrast, GNN-based predictors can improve accuracy, but often depend on labeled architectures, graph encoders, and costly representation learning, which makes them less suitable for extreme few-shot settings. We propose FENAS, a topology-agnostic few-shot prediction framework that turns complementary initialization priors into robust ranking signals. Its core component, CAST, is a feature pipeline that combines copula alignment and synergy transformation. CAST maps heterogeneous ZCPs into a compact feature manifold, enabling lightweight meta-learners to produce reliable rankings from scarce supervision. On NAS-Bench-201, with only 0.5% labeled samples, FENAS achieves a Kendall's Tau ($τ$) of 0.70, outperforming representative topology-based few-shot predictors in this low-label regime. In closed-domain search, FENAS evaluates the NAS-Bench-201 space in approximately 1138 seconds and achieves competitive test accuracy. By providing a fast, reliable, and structurally simple evaluation mechanism, FENAS supports the design of automated neural architectures under limited evaluation budgets.

AI.brief_summary: FENAS 提出一种拓扑无关的少数样本（few-shot）架构性能预测框架，其核心 CAST 流水线通过 copula 对齐与协同变换把多个异构零成本代理（ZCP）映射为紧凑特征流形，使轻量元学习器在极少标注下给出可靠排序，并用它加速 NAS 搜索。
AI.relevance_reason: 「融合多个异构廉价信号 + 少样本监督得到排序」的 CAST 思路，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设或视觉证据的筛选与聚合提供可借鉴线索；copula 对齐与协同变换能否迁移到 latent 相似度打分值得核查，但原文验证的是 NAS 场景，迁移属推测。
